title: Tamagoyaki rice with edamame
summary: A rolled Japanese omelette seasoned with mirin and tamari, sliced over rice with edamame and spinach. Quick, and mostly hands-on for ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Beat the eggs with the mirin, tamari and a pinch of salt. Rinse the rice. Slice the spring onion.
Cook the rice in the water, covered, for 10 minutes. Stir the edamame and spinach into the hot rice, cover again and leave them to warm through.
Oil the frying pan and pour in a thin layer of egg. When it is just set, roll it to one side, add another layer and roll again until the egg is used.
steps.tip: Keep the heat moderate. A fierce pan browns the outside before the middle sets.

steps.instruction: Slide the roll onto a board, slice it, and serve on the rice with spring onion and sesame seeds.
